overview: It's a new millennium - Madonna, Moloko and Basement Jaxx top the charts, and there's a whole world to explore. But teenager Byron is stuck in a small working-class town that hasn't been the same since the coal mine shut in the 80s. Sick of mam, sick of dad, sick of being beaten up for "talkin' like a poof". Sick of everyone shuffling about like the living dead, going on about kitchens they're too skint to do up and marriages they're too scared to leave. Byron needs to get away, and doesn't care how. Life explodes in a rush when Byron escapes to Nottingham's kinetic underworld and discovers the East Midlands' premier podium-dancer-cum-hellraiser, the mesmerising Lady Die. Byron is adopted into Lady Die's hilarious and chaotic family of trouble-makers – "The Fallen Divas". Between them, they beg, steal and skank their way on a rollercoaster ride of hedonism at the heart of the UK's early 2000s club scene. The party can't last though, and when Byron is seduced by bad-boy Liam, a shocking encounter occurs that will change life forever. Joyful, frank and packed with memorable characters, What It Feels Like for a Girl is a journey of love and danger, self-discovery and self-destruction. Because to find yourself sometimes you need to lose yourself...
title: What It Feels Like for a Girl

overview: Tittybangbang is a female-led television sketch comedy, performed by Lucy Montgomery and Debbie Chazen, which ran between 2005 and 2007 on BBC Three. The show was largely written by Bob Mortimer and Jill Parker and produced by their company Pett Productions.
title: Tittybangbang

overview: A down-and-out sports betting writer is roped into teaming up with the ghost of a bossy business tycoon demanding to crack his own murder case.
title: Bir İhtimal Daha Var

overview: Join a different dynamic duo every episode for more conversation after the show ends, with extra laughs and deeper discussions than ever before.
title: Loose Women: Just Between Us…

overview: A thrilling drone's eye view of history. This series of short documentaries offers a dynamic perspective on British history through hard-to-access places and untold stories. Agile drones bring us to historic locations we would not normally be able to visit, and enable us to see them from angles and heights we'd never be able to experience otherwise. As well as the historical information, the films are intended to be a visceral viewing experience in which the sheer pleasure of flying through narrow spaces and into apertures is at the core. The distinctive, entertaining narration is delivered by the popular British comedian Paul Chowdhry, who mixes a fascination for history with an irreverent, surreal sense of humour. Each episode features a different, contrasting location, and the programmes range across historic periods and themes, from the Mediaeval to the Victorian, from the dissolution of the monasteries to the boom in the railways.
title: Flying Through History

overview: Vince, a charming Breakfast TV host, endures a grave trouser malfunction at the children's cancer ward on live TV, and must navigate the aftermath to save his reputation.
title: Vince

overview: The hour-long, eight-episode series follows Canadian socialite Dr. Ann Kaplan Mulholland and her entrepreneur husband Dr. Stephen Mulholland as they turn their lives upside down after the last of their six children leaves home. The two empty-nesters move to England and take on the ambitious task of turning their newly acquired medieval castle in the heart of Kent, U.K. into a luxurious world-class destination. Set in the quiet English town of Hythe, the arrival of Ann, a force of nature with grand plans and the business savvy to pull it off, takes the local community by storm. With her husband Stephen – a world-renowned plastic surgeon– at her side, the pair are ready to give Lympne Castle the makeover of its century-long lifetime. With a dedicated team of castle staff and tradesmen supporting the renovation, they contend with construction chaos, quirky events, discerning guests, and so much more. Along the way, Ann forges unexpected friendships – from elderly neighbours to the town Vicar – and what she initially saw as a business opportunity quickly evolves into something much more personal.
title: Queen of the Castle

overview: Andrei Frolov, an employee of the criminal investigation Department, is a white crow. He does not like the work methods of his colleagues, he does not want to participate in interrogations that are conducted using violence and pressure. After Andrei has neutralized the criminal, who turned out to be the grandson of an influential person, he is given an ultimatum: he must leave the wanted list at his own request, or... Andrey is transferred to the precinct, and by someone's "ill will", he is entrusted with the most difficult criminal plan, a remote area called "Molot" (Red Hammer). This is a microdistrict on the outskirts of the Metropolis, a former workers' settlement named after the Red Molotoboits. The nearest metro station is 15 minutes away by minibus, which runs "once a year as promised." A neighborhood with the typical charms of residential and working-class areas. It looks like the Wild West in some ways - it has its own laws, everyone is their own defender. In fact, the district is governed by an Authority (here the law is him). Life in the area is harsh, but for the most part, its inhabitants, despite their unpretentiousness and simplicity, turn out to be correct and real.
title: Чужой район

overview: Years ago, journalist Shen Leshui documented the lives of workers at the old Lacheng Brewery. Now she returns to Lacheng with her camera, searching for stories forgotten by time. As she revisits the lives of Cao Jun, Tu Chunyan, Qian Yichuan and Cheng Youtian, buried memories and hidden truths slowly come to light.
title: Dream

overview: A high-octane procedural about heroic first responders, as well as their family saga of power and glamour set in one of America's most diverse and dynamic cities.
title: 9-1-1: Nashville

overview: A deep dive into the daily duties of Chief Commissioner Cameron Miekelson from the Scottish Police Force. This series sees The Chief at work and at home dealing with colleagues, bams and family alike. As Miekelson wrestles with contemporary dilemmas and navigates workplace politics, he must do his best to remain relevant in an ever-changing world.
title: The Chief

overview: Podcaster and journalist Gabriel Gatehouse sets out to solve the biggest mystery in tech: who is Satoshi Nakamoto, the elusive creator of Bitcoin? But Gabriel realises in fact he's on a much bigger story. Is Bitcoin part of a conspiracy to end democracy and transform the world? Gabriel's journey takes in cryogenic freezing, old hackers on Caribbean islands, gun-toting libertarians who want to break free from the rest of the US, and gene editing in a private city state. This is a world of futuristic ideas that were once the preserve of geeks and misfits but, with Trump and Musk now in the White House, are increasingly mainstream. Bitcoin emerged in the wake of the 2008 financial crisis, invented by the pseudonymous Satoshi Nakamoto. Three years later, Satoshi disappeared.
title: Seeking Satoshi: The Mystery Bitcoin Creator

overview: Katie meets the inmates at notorious New Orleans Parish Prison, and delves into their cases to uncover what drove these women to commit the shocking crimes they've been accused of.
title: Katie Piper: Locked Up in Louisiana

overview: Lawyer Anouk Boone becomes the youngest candidate partner ever at her firm. Soon, stories start circulating about how she achieved this position. During her studies, she had an affair with the flamboyant professor Hartman. When all kinds of complaints about Hartman's transgressive behavior surface in the storm of #MeToo, Anouk's memories of him take on a different meaning.
title: De F*ckulteit

overview: The project tells about the research of climate and ecosystem, about the state of the human body in Arctic conditions. The research vessel "Professor Molchanov" rarely stands at the pier. Now for 3 weeks it is to become the Arctic floating university. The expedition route passes through the White, Barents and Kara seas. The team will go on a scientific journey to the distant lands of a unique natural zone.
title: Плавучий университет

overview: Singer Valeria will show how to make every day rich and memorable. Together with experts and celebrity guests, the host will share life hacks on style, self-care, cooking, home organization, zoopsychology and many other everyday and routine things.
title: Добрый день с Валерией

overview: She's the third daughter of the Jiang family, determined to defy societal norms and inherit the family business. She hires the low-born yet principled male lead as her bodyguard. Their worlds couldn't be more different. Her reckless behavior constantly challenges his limits, yet irresistibly draws him into a whirlpool of passion. But reality forces them apart—she's married off, and he enlists in the army. When the nation collapses and she falls into despair, he returns to save her. Amid the chaos, they finally confess their love.
title: Bound by Sin

overview: On Abolish Everything!, comedian-abolitionists roast a pet peeve they want banned from society, while a panel of improvisers dubbed "The Political Establishment" argue on behalf of the status quo. The audience chooses their champion each episode, each of whom will come back to compete in the season finale.
title: Abolish Everything!

overview: World leaders and their top advisers tell the inside story of two decades of conflict that saw diplomacy fail and Hamas's power grow, leading up to the attacks of 7th October 2023.
title: Israel and the Palestinians: The Road to 7th October

overview: Vincenzo Palmieri, a student of the famous Commissioner Rizzo "Piedone", returns to Naples to face his past. He must earn the trust of his new team and demonstrate the effectiveness of his unconventional methods in a complex city. Commissioner Sonia Ascarelli, his opposite, will give him a hard time. Between investigations full of twists and turns and light-hearted moments, Vincenzo will try to reconcile himself with his inner demons, while Naples continues to offer valuable life lessons.
title: Piedone - Uno sbirro a Napoli

overview: Follows the fearless warrior Janos Hunyadi who defeated the Ottoman Army and defended Europe in 1456.
title: Hunyadi

overview: Max and Benj Cave are two of the UK's best free runners. They're now keen to explore the world and put their incredible skills to the test.
title: Running the World

overview: Go beyond the pitch with unparalleled access to the players and personalities who power MLS. Electrifying moments and captivating stories made 2024 an unforgettable season - and gave us a glimpse of the future.
title: Onside: Major League Soccer

overview: "Fascinating Places" - a journey to the wild places of the globe for free online on TVP VOD! The authors of the German travel series invite viewers on a trip to amazing, little-known places all over the planet. They set off with their cameras to corners that captivate with their rich fauna and flora and delight with the beauty of their landscapes.
title: Fascynujące Miejsca

overview: Taking viewers inside sports' fiercest rivalries, where every game is more than a contest—it's a battle for pride, redemption, and legacy. Uncover the grudges that fuel legendary showdowns, turning rivalries into iconic moments in sports history.
title: The Grudge

overview: A documentary series offering an intimate look at University of Alabama football during the transformative 2024 season. With Coach Kalen DeBoer stepping in after Nick Saban's legendary tenure, the series explores the core values that shape players into champions. More than just about wins and losses, it delves into athletic, academic, and spiritual growth, capturing the deep connections that bind the team, its community, and the enduring legacy of Crimson Tide football.
title: The Tides That Bind: Inside Alabama Football

overview: Small-town crime journalist Abhishek finds his life and career affected by a fugitive gangster. As he gets trapped in a web of lies and motives, what price will he pay- to become a renowned reporter?
title: Crime Beat

overview: TV journalist Yuri Rogozin is trying to understand the circumstances of his colleague Nadezhda's death. The assumption that her death may be connected to a journalistic investigation leaves him no room for compromise or easy solutions, forcing him to go all the way.
title: Поворот ключа

overview: The series takes place in a sports and beauty complex, where a group of friends, relatively young and well-off, gather on Sundays: after all, visiting a bathhouse in this complex is not a cheap pleasure. The women undergo health procedures and at the same time have endless conversations. Regular meetings on Sundays give the friends the opportunity to speak out: during the week, each of them has a lot of events that they need to tell each other about - and they share their experiences, ask each other for advice and, of course, gossip. The viewers are presented with a whole gallery of women's destinies - so different and at the same time so similar. After all, all visitors to the "women's bathhouse" without exception are concerned with the same problems: money, sex, external attractiveness, relationships with husbands, lovers, children and parents, career ups and downs, fortune telling, dreams and omens. But the main thing is that all women are united by the eternal dream of simple human happiness...
title: Воскресенье в женской бане

overview: Strangers You Know is a hard-hitting crime documentary mini series in which each episode takes you to the heart of a brutal incident that gripped the nation.
title: Strangers You Know

overview: The series, produced by Pastel Film, explores a world where lives full of secrets collide amidst love, betrayal, and power struggles
title: Piyasa

overview: This Italian drama tells the true story of beloved TV host Enzo Tortora, whose life is upended when he's falsely named in a criminal ring.
title: Portobello

overview: Jaka, a policeman filled with revenge, teams up with his junior, Sekar, and three inmates to hunt down a serial killer. Their research slowly reveals the dark side of the justice system that they have always believed in.
title: Bad Guys

overview: Jack is a determined and passionate candidate who wins a national pageant and gears up for an international competition. However, as he chases his dream, he faces the harsh realities and controversies surrounding male pageantry, putting his resilience and integrity to the test. This is the Journey of Jack, Tomas, and the rest of the candidates as they fight for the crown—and for something even greater.
title: Sashes and Hearts

overview: Drama series about four female friends' marital and extramarital relationships.
title: Mistresses

overview: "Coco" Oderigo, an upper-class lawyer, founds the Spartans, the first rugby team in a prison.
title: Espartanos. Una historia real

overview: Andrew Chang goes beyond the headlines and explains the major news stories everybody is talking about.
title: About That with Andrew Chang

overview: The latest national weather forecast with Irish Sign Language (ISL).
title: ISL Weekly Weather

overview: Deana Sumanac-Johnson brings Canadians the latest breaking news and live coverage from across Canada and around the world.
title: CBC Newsroom with Deana Sumanac-Johnson

overview: A lively discussion on an issue of national interest. Hosted by Ian Hanomansing. Simulcast with CBC Radio One.
title: Cross Country Checkup on CBC News Network, with Ian Hanomansing

overview: Aarti Pole brings Canadians the latest breaking news and live coverage from across Canada and around the world.
title: CBC Newsroom with Aarti Pole

overview: Andrew Nichols in Toronto brings Canadians the latest breaking news.
title: CBC Newsroom with Andrew Nichols

overview: A 16-year-old high school student, Nismet lives in a small town in the Marseille region, between a depressed mother and a tyrannical and violent stepfather. While the latter tries to sexually assault her and faced with the passivity of her mother, the young girl runs away. From home to home, and faced with the tragedy that will soon affect her family, she will have to find the path to emancipation and free herself from its independence.
title: Nismet

overview: In 1989 Dalhousie, Kismat's arrival and a mysterious bracelet lead to unexplained events that make Jeet and her question what's happening around them?
title: Inanma

overview: The ideal of masculinity - as unattainable as it is frustrating - is in crisis. The series Virile delves into the history and myths of masculinity with humor and wit.
title: Viril

overview: Nol Ratsamee is a heartbroken, woman-hating, completely introverted, angry, handsome young man. His former girlfriend screwed him over and left him for his best friend, and took his money. His depressive state and views on love and women garner the attention of his younger sister, who is very concerned, so she teams up with her bubbly/cheerful best friend Reuangrin Narokmon to find him a girl and to make him be ‘happy' again. Reungrin moves into their home as a maidservant to get close to Nol, to know his habits and likes, so that she can play his matchmaker. But a problem arises, and Reuangrin begins to fall for Nol.
title: Sao Chai Hi-Tech

overview: Meesni is a story that revolves around Sahira, played by Maham Shahid, a young, beautiful but cunning girl who leaves no stone unturned to get what she wants. She has always deceived people including her own family by constantly lying to them. She manipulates people for her personal gains. She uses all malicious ways to get whatever she lacks through different ploys. HUM TV presents the drama Meesni as a story of greed, deception and repercussions. Featuring the versatile Sharmeen Kashif, Bilal Qureshi, Maham Shahid in lead roles, the serial sheds light on malicious motives of people for greed and complexes. Repercussions of blind trust and effects on generations to come.
title: Meesni

overview: A story about love and relationships that could turn anyone into a loser. It will be portrayed in the form of a romantic comedy that shows the inherent pathetic sides of people and diverse thrilling moments that come with various forms of love. The hyperrealistic depiction of humans at their lowest will be accompanied by laughter and empathy that goes beyond discomfort. Seo Min Ki is a freshman in college who is majoring in Korean literature. He is a hesitant person with a lot on his mind who sometimes makes bold actions. Being a 20-year-old, the result of his actions are always a series of clumsiness and mistakes. However, because he's someone who thinks a lot and has an ideological personality, he always self-reflects. He is a simple outsider whose only wish is to drink with his friends and play games at internet cafes.
title: History Of Losers

overview: Archie Pepper interviews four of the Scottish party leaders.
title: Leaders off the Record

overview: Chief Cameron Miekelson gives viewers his unique take on the nation's capital, looking at the history, geography and literature of Edinburgh, including a heated discussion with acclaimed author Ian Rankin.
title: The Chief Does Edinburgh

overview: Dumped and broke, Novelette, a queer Black woman, gets a roommate, Audre. Their contrasting personalities clash. Novelette confronts her dependency issues, gains confidence, and pursues love as she learns to stand on her own.
title: Novelette Is Trying

overview: Special coverage on CBC News Network.
title: CBC News: Live News Special

overview: Doireann Ní Ghlacáin heads off with her fiddle on her back, to find out what is happening at the heart of the traditional Irish music scene in four different areas around Ireland. We've been told for years that west Clare, Sliabh Luachra and Donegal are where it's at in terms of trad, but is that still the case? Doireann delves into the music scene in less recognized areas, musically speaking, to see who is playing, what they are playing and where the craic is at.
title: Ceolaireacht

overview: At the engagement banquet between the Ling and Gao families, the Gao patriarch and his daughter attempt to humiliate Ling Feng using the attending media. However, Ling Feng preemptively strikes, dramatically declaring to the press that his true fiancée is Xu Ya—a blind cellist invited to perform at the event. Yet Xu Ya, who appears to be an unwitting pawn in this power play, is far from the innocent victim she appears to be…
title: Kan Bu Jian De He Yue Lian Ren

overview: Five siblings face endless missions in this pure entertainment variety show. With a few screws loose, they embrace chaos in their search for sanity.
title: Screwballs

overview: Greta's life unravels after finding a mysterious photograph of her husband from years ago. When he disappears, she is forced to uncover his dark past.
title: Tylko jedno spojrzenie

overview: In Elixer Isabelle Rombauts becomes totally unexpected the CEO of family business Rombauts Pharma, an important player on the international pharmaceutical market. She soon encounters the consequences of serious mismanagement by her father and brother. And she is faced with a devilish dilemma: should she follow her own conscience? Or the interests of her influential family?
title: Elixer

overview: Hoping to improve his reputation, disgraced ex-TV reporter Ippei runs for City Council and moves in with his late sister's husband and his family to win.
title: Japan's Number One Jerk Salaryman

overview: Tomàs Fuentes and Ignasi Taltavull comment on and judge the worst anecdote of the people who come to the program from the public. The most miserable story wins a prize.
title: La Ruina

overview: This series explores the intersection of extreme wealth and violent crime, investigating how the pursuit of money, power, and status can lead to murder. Each episode focuses on a high-profile case, where either the victim or the perpetrator had considerable wealth, examining the motivations behind the crimes and the investigations that followed. With expert commentary and archive footage, the series delves into the often-complex factors that contribute to such crimes. Cases featured include the murder of William Saunderson-Smith, who lived ‘under the radar', using different identities to conceal a sprawling property empire in London and the killing of Anthony Ashley-Cooper, 10th Earl of Shaftesbury.
title: Millionaire Murders

overview: This British series examines notorious murders that have had a lasting impact on rural communities in the UK. Each episode revisits a case that shocked once-peaceful towns and villages, highlighting how these seemingly idyllic settings were forever changed by violent crime. The series includes contributions from retired police detectives, forensic psychologists, and local journalists who provide detailed analysis of the investigative process behind each case.
title: Britain's Countryside Killers

overview: Subterranea, Kenya's first sci-fi series, follows eight participants of a psychological experiment who are placed in an underground bunker to test the effects of close-quarter secluded relationships on humans.
title: Subterranea

overview: Incredible events, modern achievements, cataclysms and mysterious coincidences, amazing inventions and mystical phenomena - all this will be told by three hosts of the program "Beyond the Real": Sergey Druzhko, Petr Korneev and Vasilisa Shatunova. "Beyond the Real" is an educational project about events and phenomena that expand our horizons and turn our understanding of the world around us upside down! The daily TV magazine "Beyond the Real" covers the entire spectrum of interests of the audience that wants to learn more about this world and what is beyond reality. What is a UFO? What threatens humanity? Who really lived on Earth before us? And much more...
title: За гранью реального

overview: An entertaining TV game about inhuman greed
title: Деньги не пахнут

overview: Is it possible to walk around all of Russia and get acquainted with the life of each nation? Perhaps this is within the power of one Grandfather-Regionalist named Ignat Matveevich. He has lived in this world for so long that he has been able to visit almost every city in our unique country. Today he is ready to tell all TV viewers about his adventures. The stories of Grandfather-Regionalist include the nature of Russian regions, so diverse and amazing, and the brightest cultural traditions of the peoples, and of course a local fairy tale!
title: В гостях у деда-краеведа

overview: Quiet town in Danmark. Alicia is gathering her friends all over the world (mostly from Poland) to a party. Nothing special, but this night will became a murder mystery.
title: Пан или пропал

overview: Searching for Spain invites viewers to journey with Longoria across Spain's sun-drenched plains, rugged mountains and dramatic seascapes exploring its incredible wealth of cultures, climates and cuisines. This season, Longoria tastes her way through a bar crawl of pintxos in San Sebastián, Catalan prawns in Barcelona, and the iconic Spanish tortilla in Madrid. She ventures to the birthplace of tapas and samples some of the most expensive jamon in the world in Andalusia. In Galicia, she savors a bounty of fresh seafood and world class Galician blonde beef. Among the cider mills of Asturias, she explores the land of her ancestors and visits with family who still live in the town of Longoria to this day. Finally, audiences get a special peek into her new Spanish home in Marbella as she hosts a feast of local delicacies for her closest friends.
title: Eva Longoria: Searching for Spain

overview: Condemned property investor and rehabber Kristyn Patterson and her builder father, Pancho Patterson, will stop at nothing to rescue The Motor City's worst houses that are destined for the wrecking ball. To breathe new life into the forgotten properties, Kristyn and Pancho will face harsh realities—including their hard-earned money on the line, squatters living in their houses, a brutal winter and the city's strict renovation deadlines—to help transform Detroit's historic neighborhoods.
title: Condemned

overview: Follow the intellectual and emotional journey of a group of medical students at Albert Einstein College of Medicine in the Bronx. Captured through verité scenes and personal video diaries, the film offers an inside look at America's healthcare system through the eyes of these aspiring practitioners as they learn what it takes to become a doctor in one of the country's most underserved communities. Filmed in the corridors and classrooms at Albert Einstein — which announced in February 2024 that it is now tuition-free, thanks to a $1 billion gift from longtime faculty member Dr. Ruth Gottesman — and at its teaching hospital, Montefiore Medical Center, The Calling: A Medical School Journey follows the first-year students as they struggle to keep up with the punishing workload, meet and dissect their first cadavers, and engage with real patients for the first time. Meanwhile, the third-year students rotate through different medical specialties, juggling long shifts in the hospital with marathon study sessions for the all-important exams that will help determine where they will do their residencies. Through it all, the film chronicles the students' hopes, fears and incredible growth as they navigate the many challenges facing today's medical practitioners.
title: The Calling: A Medical School Journey

overview: Oprah Winfrey hosts various primetime specials on ABC.
title: An Oprah Winfrey Special

overview: Fred Sirieix - TV's favourite Frenchman - is setting the wheels in motion! Join him as he cycles on the spectacular and sometimes gruelling roads of Northern Ireland.
title: Tour De Fred: Northern Ireland

overview: The report Cztery Pory Igi presents the most important moments of this season in chronological order. There will be no shortage of sporting competitions at the highest level and the thrills and excitement that accompany them.
title: Cztery Pory Igi

overview: Pop Whiz is a travelling trivia game show that will challenge teens from across Canada on their Pop Culture Knowledge.
title: Pop Whiz

overview: Mafia: Most Wanted offers audiences insight into the ‘Ndrangheta, a powerful Italian organized crime syndicate, and its deep roots in Canada, where its allegedly been involved in drug trafficking, theft, financial fraud, extortion, and murder. The series challenges the perception of the Mafia as an "open secret," shedding light on the inner workings of a Toronto crime family, and the individuals behind the infamous names. Included in the docuseries are interviews with former mob enforcers Joe Ferraro and biker turned police informant Cecil Kirby, plus crime writer James Dubro, investigative journalist Joseph Loiero, and retired RCMP sergeants Larry Tronstad and Brad Trainor. Their firsthand accounts, combined with undercover surveillance footage, wiretaps, police intelligence files, and dramatic recreations, paint a vivid and disturbing picture of the brutality of organized crime in Canada, and the devastating consequences of their actions.
title: Mafia: Most Wanted

overview: We live in an era when everything seems easy to find a scientific explanation for. The planet has been studied far and wide. However, the world jealously guards its secrets, and scientists can only build hypotheses, trying to unravel them. The Lake of Skeletons in India, the ice worms of Antarctica, the rotating island in Argentina, the mysteries of chronomirages, the ghost train that disappeared in the fog, the secrets of the Blue Hole in the Red Sea, ... All this and other mysteries are in the REN TV channel project "The Main Secrets of the World".
title: Главные тайны мира

overview: When successful wedding planner Dassy suddenly finds herself single again, her grandmother casts an ancient love potion to summon up Dassy's one true love. But something goes wrong with Grandma's spell, and suddenly Dassy is spoiled for choice! Instead of just "The One", Dassy now has four suitors from her past and present vying for her heart. With just two weeks to organize a high-stakes wedding for her high school mean girl, Dassy must navigate this romantic chaos and decide which man – if any – leads to her own "happily ever after".
title: Save the Date

overview: An unexpected look at the most incredible events of history and modern times. You will travel to places that are not on the map, the mysteries of dangerous relics and ancient prophecies. Inexplicable facts and historical sensations of different eras will be studied - and will find a convincing explanation. The host of the program is a traveler, historian, specialist in secret societies, a world-renowned expert in the field of Eastern religions, the author of books on the history of the occult and intelligence.
title: Загадки человечества с Олегом Шишкиным

overview: The Croatian edition of The Bachelor. The series follows a single bachelor who is given a list of romantic interests from which he must choose a fiancée. During the season, the bachelor eliminates candidates each week which finally results in his last choice receiving a marriage proposal.
title: Gospodin Savršeni

overview: When Lindiwe Mkhwanazi takes a team of women boxers to a major tournament, she must overcome sabotage from within her own organization.
title: Pound 4 Pound

overview: Five couples agree to test their relationship by spending their vacation in separate corners of an island.
title: La isla de las tentaciones
